prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic portrait of a young man with tousled brown hair, leaning casually on an orange basketball. He wears a crisp white dress shirt with the sleeves slightly rolled up, layered under a dark vest, giving a modern, preppy school vibe. His expression is relaxed and slightly open-mouthed, conveying a sense of youthful nonchalance and introspection. The background is softly blurred, with another young man in a navy blue school uniform and striped tie, standing out of focus, adding depth and a sense of narrative to the scene. The color palette is soft and warm, with natural daylight streaming in, creating gentle highlights and a dreamy, almost ethereal atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to draw attention to the main subject, while the background figure hints at a story or relationship. The overall style is reminiscent of a coming-of-age film, with a gentle, contemplative mood and a focus on subtle emotion and character.
